title: Remember this process: create a holon, scan the chain, mark it in progress, settle decisions by principle, walk delivery, split if unsafe, pre-empt stops with one focused owner session (2026-10-28)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
This process feels like one that we should remember. 

Creating a holon of work. 
Identifying all the items in the chain
Marking it as an in progress unit
Identifying any decisions and applying principles 
Walking through the process that would be required to deliver the holon
(Split holon if there is no way to deliver it safely)
Preemptively addressing issues ( using owner attention in one focussed session... Not split over pieces of the delivery)

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-10-28, while the affirmation unit (semanticops.com#42) was being driven; recorded verbatim.
